name: Slimy Warthog 37
author: Pradeepsaranbishnoi
description: Neon sky-blue radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 0.0625em #0043ed, background-color changes from #fff to #dee7ff, z-index becomes 1. On focus, outline becomes 0, border-color becomes #2260ff, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 4px #b5c9fc.
